36761-charles-edward-putney-an-appreciat.title: Charles Edward Putney An Appreciation
36761-charles-edward-putney-an-appreciat.creator: Unknown
36761-charles-edward-putney-an-appreciat.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He enlisted in the Thirteenth New Hampshire Volunteers, and later became a sergeant. He was in the war over three years and took part in the battles of Fredericksburg, siege of Suffolk, Port Walthal, Swift Creek, Kingsland Creek, Drewrys Bluff, Cold Harbor, Petersburg, Fort McConhie, Fort Harrison, and Richmond. He was one of the first four men to enter Richmond after the surrender.

arxiv-2110-03724.title: Defect-driven antiferromagnetic domain walls in CuMnAs films
arxiv-2110-03724.creator: Sonka Reimers, Dominik Kriegner, Olena Gomonay, Dina Carbone, Filip Krizek, Vit Novák, Richard P. Campion, Francesco Maccherozzi, Alexander Björling, Oliver J. Amin, Luke X. Barton, Stuart F. Poole, Khalid A. Omari, Jan Michalička, Ondřej Man, Jairo Sinova, Tomáš Jungwirth, Peter Wadley, Sarnjeet S.
arxiv-2110-03724.description: Abstract Efficient manipulation of antiferromagnetic (AF) domains and domain walls has opened up new avenues of research towards ultrafast, high-density spintronic devices. AF domain structures are known to be sensitive to magnetoelastic effects, but the microscopic interplay of crystalline defects, strain and magnetic ordering remains largely unknown.

arxiv-2110-04642.title: Journalistic Voting System’s Effects on Election Security Threats and Gerrymandering
arxiv-2110-04642.creator: Lucius Schoenbaum
arxiv-2110-04642.description: Abstract The Journalistic Voting System is a proxy voting system in which journalists are delegated the task of voting on behalf of individual voters in a western-style democracy. We introduce the Journalistic Voting System and discuss its potential advantages and potential problems.

arxiv-2203-06287.title: Resilient UAV Formation for Coverage and Connectivity of Spatially Dispersed Users
arxiv-2203-06287.creator: Yuhui Wang, Junaid Farooq
arxiv-2203-06287.description: Abstract Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are a convenient choice for carrying mobile base stations to rapidly setup communication services for ground users. arxiv-2211-11390.title: State Estimation for Hybrid Locomotion of Driving-Stepping Quadrupeds
arxiv-2211-11390.creator: Mojtaba Hosseini, Diego Rodriguez, Sven Behnke
arxiv-2211-11390.description: Abstract Fast and versatile locomotion can be achieved with wheeled quadruped robots that drive quickly on flat terrain, but are also able to overcome challenging terrain by adapting their body pose and by making steps. In this paper, we present a state estimation approach for four-legged robots with non-steerable wheels that enables hybrid driving-stepping locomotion capabilities.

arxiv-2306-02355.title: Observations of the Current Sheet Heating in X-ray during a Solar Flare Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2306-02355.creator: A.A Reva, S.A. Bogachev, I.P. Loboda, A.S. Ulyanov, A.S. Kirichenko
arxiv-2306-02355.description: Abstract In the solar corona, magnetic reconnection occurs due to the finite resistivity of the plasma. At the same time, resistivity leads to ohmic heating. Therefore, the reconnecting current sheet should heat the surrounding plasma. This paper presents experimental evidence of such plasma heating caused by magnetic reconnection. We observed the effect during a C1.

arxiv-2306-11805.title: Closed-form expressions for the pure time delay in terms of the input and output Laguerre spectra
arxiv-2306-11805.creator: Alexander Medvedev
arxiv-2306-11805.description: Abstract The pure time delay operator is considered in continuous and discrete time under the assumption of the input signal being integrable (summable) with square. By making use of a discrete convolution operator with polynomial Markov parameters, a common framework for handling the continuous and discrete case is set.

arxiv-2406-18661.title: Deriving the star formation histories of galaxies from spectra with simulation-based inference
arxiv-2406-18661.creator: Patricia Iglesias-Navarro, Marc Huertas-Company, Ignacio Martín-Navarro, Johan H. Knapen, Emilie Pernet
arxiv-2406-18661.description: Abstract High-resolution galaxy spectra encode information about the stellar populations within galaxies. The properties of the stars, such as their ages, masses, and metallicities, provide insights into the underlying physical processes that drive the growth and transformation of galaxies over cosmic time.

The neurotransmitter dopamine (DA) is essential for learning in a Pavlovian fear conditioning paradigm known as fear-potentiated startle (FPS). pmc-10702005.title: Inflow control can be safely used in laparoscopic subsegmentectomy of the liver: a single-center 10-year experience
pmc-10702005.creator: Hao-Ping Wang, Teng-Yuan Hou, Wei-Feng Li, Chee-Chien Yong
pmc-10702005.description: BackgroundSeveral techniques have been developed to reduce blood loss in liver resection. The half-Pringle and Pringle maneuvers are commonly used for inflow control. This study compared the outcomes of different inflow control techniques in laparoscopic subsegmentectomy.MethodsFrom October 2010 to December 2020, a total of 362 laparoscopic liver resections were performed by a single surgeon (C.C. Yong) in our institute.

pmc-11325519.title: Churning-Motion-Assisted Bubble Removal: A Low-Cost Approach for Enhancing PDMS Mixture Quality
pmc-11325519.creator: Anoop Kanjirakat, Naresh Kumar Mani, Dolfred Vijay Fernandes
pmc-11325519.description: Bubble formation during mixing of the base elastomer and the curing agent for polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) preparation presents a significant challenge, traditionally addressed through vacuum degassing or centrifugation. This study introduces a novel alternative for bubble removal in PDMS mixtures: a churning motion inspired by industrial dairy separation processes.

pmc-11527160.title: Improvement of multiscale decomposition for space-based gravitational wave signal processing technology
pmc-11527160.creator: Qiuping Shen, Yunqing Liu, Dongpo Xu, Fei Yan, Siyuan Wu, Xin Chen
pmc-11527160.description: During the process of detecting gravitational waves in space, addressing noise issues caused by terrestrial vibrations, natural environmental changes, and the factors intrinsic to the detectors, this paper proposes a multiscale variational mode adaptive denoising algorithm based on momentum gradient descent.

pmc-12467542.title: Targeting Fear of Cancer Recurrence with Internet-Based Emotional Freedom Techniques (iEFT) and Mindfulness Meditation Intervention (iMMI) (BGOG-gyn1b/REMOTE)
pmc-12467542.creator: Laura Tack, Lore Mertens, Marte Vandeweyer, Fien Florin, Emma Pauwels, Thaïs Baert, Tom Boterberg, Christel Fontaine, Kurt Geldhof, Caroline Lamot, Christine Langenaeken, Jeroen Mebis, Laure-Anne Teuwen, Katherine Vandenborre, Heidi Van den Bulck, Florence Van Ryckeghem, Mohammad Najlah, Patricia Sc
pmc-12467542.description: Approximately one-third of cancer survivors report a need for professional help to cope with Fear of Cancer Recurrence (FCR). In the REMOTE trial, we aim to investigate the efficacy of two internet-based mind-body techniques to address this currently unmet medical need.

pmc-12471394.title: Preparation of Hydrophobic Glass Surfaces by Femtosecond Laser
pmc-12471394.creator: Xuyun Peng, Xiaojun Tan, Wei Tan, Jian Huang, Chaojun Ding, Yushan Yang, Jieshun Yang, Haitao Chen, Liang Guo, Qingmao Zhang
pmc-12471394.description: Functional glass surfaces with tunable wettability are of growing interest in optical, biomedical, and architectural applications. In this study, we investigate the influence of femtosecond laser processing parameters—including power, scanning speed, and repetition rate—on the surface morphology, wettability, and optical properties of Panda glass.

pmc-12692117.title: Multi-Target Botanical Complex Attenuates Cellular Senescence via Bidirectional P21/P53/SIRT1 Regulation: Dual Model Validation
pmc-12692117.creator: Jiaqin Wu, Nanjia Dongzhu, Chengzhou Zhao, Jialin Liang, Ningbo Wang, Dengdeng Suonan, Shengnan Sun, Calogero Caruso
pmc-12692117.description: Cellular senescence is a pivotal driver of aging and age-related diseases. This study aims to systematically investigate the anti-senescence effects and molecular mechanisms of a multi-component botanical complex (SBT) using both a D-galactose-induced senescence model in H9c2 cardiomyocytes and an H2O2-induced accelerated aging model in zebrafish. The SBT complex comprises Solms-laubachia eurycarpa, Bergenia purpurascens, Laccifer lacca, and Glycyrrhiza uralensis.

pmc-12738781.title: Research on the possibility of using olive pit biomass in recycling metals from slag
pmc-12738781.creator: Albert Smalcerz, Jerzy Łabaj, Szymon Ptak, Robert Findorak, Tomasz Matuła, Marzena Półka, Tomasz Wojtal, Leszek Blacha
pmc-12738781.description: According to the EU Sustainable Development Goals, it is necessary to search for new technologies that promote sustainable development and optimize the use of resources, raw materials and energy. This article presents the results of research on the use of biomass in metal recycling processes.

pmc-13253634.title: Statistical association of complete PYHIN gene family loss with flight and inverted roosting in bats
pmc-13253634.creator: Chanasei Ziemann, Madeline Streicher, Allyssa Sicks, Chi Zhang, Luwen Zhang
pmc-13253634.description: The PYHIN (pyrin and HIN domain–containing) gene family encodes central cytosolic DNA sensors, including AIM2 and IFI16, that activate inflammasome and type I interferon pathways during infection. While these pathways are critical for antiviral and antimicrobial defense, how ecological pressures shape their evolution remain unclear. The PYHIN gene family varies across mammals, and bats have completely lost all PYHIN genes.

pmc-13369504.title: The effect of narrative medicine-based education on academic performance and humanistic communication in residency training: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13369504.creator: Dongjun Dai, Yuzhi Fan, Wenbao Zhang, Qichun Wei
pmc-13369504.description: Our study aims to assess the effect of narrative medicine education on academic performance and humanistic communication. We performed a PRISMA guideline-based systematic review and meta-analysis. The literature was searched in PubMed, Embase, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, VIP database and Wanfang database up to January 26, 2026. Two independent reviewers performed the study selection, data extraction and quality assessment.

pmc-13451191.title: Autism in adolescence and adulthood
pmc-13451191.creator: Kristina Denisova, Catherine R. G. Jones
pmc-13451191.description: Landmark descriptions of autism in the 1940s were based on clinical work with children. Research over the subsequent 80 years has largely focused on the experiences and needs of autistic children, with recent neuroimaging and genetic studies contributing significant insights into the developmentally driven neurobiological underpinnings of this condition.
